note: Rewritten from Sands' (1999) new species description, original in English; the genus lacks soldiers, only the worker has a complete description; measurements follow the original ranges (the original gives the hind tibia length as 0.597—0.6436 mm, reproduced here as printed).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: With A. autothysius it forms a terminal pair, adjacent in almost all trees, differing only in the shorter apical spines of the primary rows and the less clearly outlined secondary-row scales. From A. ivorensis it differs in that the latter is slightly larger, has the anterior margin of the first marginal tooth of the right mandible as long as that of the second marginal tooth, fewer apical spines on ridges one and three of the primary rows, and very sparse secondary rows. From A. mayombei it differs in that the latter has the anterior margin of the third marginal tooth of the left mandible nearly as long as that of the first marginal tooth, the longest primary-row spines not wider than the narrowest point of ridge three and fewer than 10 on ridge one, and a bilaterally symmetrical valve. From A. mbalmayoensis it differs in that the latter is much larger, the longest primary-row spines not wider than the narrowest point of ridge three, the secondary rows consisting of single small spines on the scales, and the valve six-radiate.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish white or pale yellow, the darkest part of the antennal flagellum yellow or pale yellowish brown, pronotum and legs yellowish white, abdominal tergites transparent. Head capsule short-oval, nearly circular or oval, setae sparse, projecting, the longest setae scattered at random. Fontanelle present as a pale spot or absent. Fore coxa without stout setae, or with 4 or more stout setae on the anterior surface arranged in rows or groups; fore tibia with 3 distal spurs, the third well developed (at least one-half the length of the others) or far smaller than the other two. Left mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth distinctly longer than the posterior margin or nearly equilateral, anterior margin of the third marginal tooth shorter than that of the first marginal tooth, the proximal end of the fourth marginal tooth not touching the molar prominence or just touching its lateral edge in frontal view; right mandible: anterior margin of the first marginal tooth shorter. Measurements: head width 0.598—0.635 mm; pronotum width 0.390—0.424 mm, length 0.168—0.246 mm; hind tibia length 0.597—0.6436 mm; fore tibia length 0.495—0.535 mm; left mandible index 0.751—0.935, right mandible index 0.895—1.228.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: The midgut–hindgut junction arises ventrally to the left of the nerve cord or below it; the first hindgut segment is rather short, up to 8 times as long as its proximal width, tubular throughout; in the undissected abdomen the enteric valve lies to the right of the heart (dorsal view) or to the left of the nerve cord (ventral view); the third lobe of the enteric valve seat is smaller than the outer pair. The enteric valve ridges are markedly waisted at the base of the apical spines and then widen, the ends sclerotized, pale brown or yellowish brown; the primary rows bear very long tapering spines, ridges one and three with 10—20 largest apical spines, ridges two and four with 1—9, the longest curved but evenly tapering, longer than the narrowest point of ridge three; the secondary rows bear sparser conspicuous spines, lengthening towards the ridge apex; the membrane between and outside the ridges bears minute spines, with marginal scales proximally.
